dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, jagged perimeters of high-intensity white pixels with a sharp gradient transition into dark, low-intensity interior cores; most distinct in the center-left and ventral-lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of bright white pixel clusters localized in narrow, meandering paths that delineate the annuli; interspersed with large, high-concentration solid dark blobs lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli in the lower-left quadrant form a non-equilateral quadrilateral with internal angles ranging from approximately 60 to 110 degrees.

other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct, elongated, light-colored ungual structures are visible on the distal edge of the dark-furred limb.
